Own critical network infrastructure, work with modern technologies and shape the evolution of IT within a stable, people-focused organisation.

Our partner is a well-established Belgian organisation operating across multiple locations, with a strong focus on service, reliability and digital transformation. Its IT environment supports a broad network of sites and business operations, making availability, security and connectivity essential to its day-to-day activities.

 

As part of a growing IT Infrastructure team, you will join an environment where networking is not simply about keeping systems running: you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work on infrastructure projects and influence how the network evolves.
Network Engineer | The Role
As a Network Engineer, you will take an active role in the operational management and continuous improvement of the organisation's network environment.

• Manage and monitor LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and firewall infrastructure across multiple locations.

jobs.occupation: CE truck driver for national transport - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

Own the roadmap of a critical provisioning platform, where DNS, IP and partner APIs meet product strategy.

Product Owner | Brussels area

Our client is a major Belgian player in connectivity and digital services, whose in-house teams build and run the platforms behind its network, its domain and IP services and its customer-facing products.

What makes it stand out? A technology organisation large enough to handle infrastructure at national scale, yet structured in product teams where ownership is real and decisions are made close to the work.

The company is modernising its provisioning and service-management platforms, moving from a legacy core towards the next generation of services, with resilience, security and compliance as constant constraints.

To drive this, it is looking for a Product Owner to define the vision, own the roadmap and set priorities across these mission-critical platforms.

 

The job

• Define and own the vision, roadmap and priorities of a critical provisioning platform, comparable in logic to OSS/BSS systems.
• Translate strategic, operational, regulatory and partner needs into clear product direction and concrete priorities.
 
Role
• Own the roadmap across the provisioning engine, DNS and IP domain management, partner integration APIs, service lifecycle and data analytics capabilities, making transparent trade-offs between value, urgency, risk and delivery capacity.
• Work closely with architecture, engineering, service delivery, compliance and security to ensure requirements are understood, feasible and aligned.
• Give clear product direction to the business analysts, validate functional requirements and acceptance criteria, and own functional acceptance through to go/no-go release decisions.
• Balance immediate operational needs — run, incidents, service commitments — with platform modernisation, resilience and security.
Profile
• Bachelor or Master Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or Information Systems.
• Around 7 years of experience in technology-driven products or services, including substantial experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager. Hands-on exposure to DNS, IP management, domain lifecycle or similar provisioning and registry protocols is a strong asset.
• Dutch or French with a good command of the other, and professional English.

A quantitative degree, a head for numbers, and a Brussels company where the calculations are the product.

Data Specialist | Brussels-Centre

Our client is an independent Belgian company active in specialised financial services, whose entire business rests on complex calculation models applied to long-term commitments.

What makes it stand out? A human-sized structure with the backing of a large group: entrepreneurial pace, short decision lines, and real proximity to the people who decide.

Its platforms are built and maintained in-house. Calculation engines, projections and regulatory reporting all run on proprietary applications, where the mathematical accuracy of the output comes before everything else.

To support its growth, the company is looking for a profile that combines quantitative work with business analysis, to help improve its internal systems.

The job

• Analyse the calculation rules and data behind the in-house applications, and turn what you find into concrete improvements to those systems.
• Act as a bridge between the business teams and the developers, translating quantitative needs into something that can be built.Role
• Model and test calculation rules, including edge cases, thresholds and exceptions, and identify where the systems can be improved.
• Verify the results produced by the applications: independent recalculations, consistency checks and investigation of discrepancies.
• Gather and challenge business needs, translate them into clear functional requirements, and take part in testing and validating what is delivered.
• Document the models, assumptions and implementation choices made.
Profile
• Master’s degree in a strongly quantitative field: mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, physics, civil engineering or equivalent. This is a firm requirement.
• Around 2 to 3 years of experience in a quantitative, analytical or business analysis role. Strong command of Excel is essential; knowledge of SQL, Python, R or VBA is an asset.
• French or Dutch with a basic knowledge of the other; English is a plus.
